verdicts.reason: A centres the headline in a balanced block, but the headline is undersized for the 614×768 canvas, the CTA has shrunk to a small pill with tiny label text, and it sits about 180px below the copy, so the headline and button no longer read as one group. B pins the headline to the top and the CTA near the bottom, leaving a roughly 400px dead orange void between them; the two pieces are completely disconnected and the layout looks top-heavy and unfinished, although the CTA keeps a better size.
